cards.title: Your round 9 notes
cards.text: Knock moves them for real, hits and kills burst, the screen shakes, and a playground to show abilities.
cards.why: Everything from the last decks. Films are in the playground now, so you can see each thing.
cards.details: Version 0.13.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it. Pause → Playground: On to try it yourself.

parts.title: Knock is motion
parts.text: Knockback is a push of speed that slides them and dies off, not a jump. The Hulk shoves you the same way, and turns snappier.

parts.title: Hit effects
parts.text: Sparks in the enemy's colour on every hit, a burst and ring on every kill, rings on blasts and pickups, shake on big hits, a red flash when you're hurt.

parts.title: Playground
parts.text: One open room; groups of 4 walk in every 4 s, never more than 10. Build anything, like practice.

parts.title: Split
parts.text: The two halves skip the enemy that split them.

parts.title: Rail budget
parts.text: 90 damage to spend: each enemy takes what it needs to die, the shot goes on with the rest.

parts.title: Clouds
parts.text: Swell from a point, fade fast at the end, and pale motes drift up out of them.

parts.title: Shard
parts.text: Bigger under-star at a third of the speed. In this clip it's the gold star at the left (top left of the screen).
